transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Yeah, nice to meet you too. Um... I guess I'm just having a hard time staying put. 

Like, whenever I'm supposed to sit still in the radiology suite at work, or in class... I just get this feeling like I'm crawling out of my skin. I've been trying to just tough it out for months, but... I don't know. I still just end up pacing or shifting around, or finding some excuse to get up and move. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did this restless feeling start after you began taking a medication or changed the dose of one?
No. Um... I don't take any medications. So... it's not that.
Were you like this as a child?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... my parents still bring up my elementary school conferences. Teachers would always say I was out of my seat, or... calling out. Rushing ahead before they even finished giving directions. So... yeah. It was happening way before middle school. It's not just something that started with my radiology training.
Do you ever pull out your hair?
No. Um... I don't do that.
Do you often feel overly worried or anxious?
No. Um... not really. I don't... I don't think I worry more than anyone else. So... no.
